scope: Independent linear Solar R2 per-wing HF-to-ROM dimension falsifier; nominal 20 ms undamped contact plus bounded contact-window sensitivity

current_round3_rom5.selection_rule: three lowest BENDING modes plus two lowest TORSION modes

dimension_combination_falsifier.score: max over LEFT/RIGHT and metrics of abs(candidate_peak-HF_peak)/max(abs(HF_peak),1e-14)

physical_cause.interpretation: The 25 Hz contact band lies between T2 and T3.  T3/T4 are physically excited and their post-contact free response is omitted by the two-torsion-mode Round3 basis.

static_residual_assessment.disposition: A static/mode-acceleration residual cannot repair a free-response peak after the half-sine force has ended; a persistent dynamic residual kernel is additional dynamics, not a five-mode ROM.
